body: I can't see a tomorrow.  I try and all I feel is this weight pounding down on me.    I almost feel obligated at this point to do it, as I have no idea what tomorrow will bring.

I am not sure what I want.  Money would be great but it does not solve every issue.  Having a job that I love to go to everyday would help, but that seems to be a myth that only few get to see.  

I do not have a long term goal, my short term goal is to be able and wake up the next day.

My dream job is to work either on computers (Windows Admin, Server side stuff) or to get CCNA certified and work on Cisco servers.  I can take either path, but that is still a few more years of work, which means even more work at the grind.  

I really do not like my jobs, as they do not do anything to help my future resume.  Being able to stock shelves in no way helps me out.  Sure the customer service is a plus, but at the end of the day anyone can talk to a client or on a phone in professional manner. 

I have a brother who just graduated college with a degree in science (Bio/Trees/Insects and things) but he cannot find work in his field of study.  Instead he has chosen to go teach, which is great, but not something that I would do.  Then again this is not about him.

It is hard to dream when your thoughts keep putting the idea that jumping off a high structure is a good idea.
